1. (Currently amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, __wherein said desiccant is provided to maintain thermal stability of said composition during storage at elevated temperatures__.

2. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __and wherein said desiccant comprises a material selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

3. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __wherein said desiccant comprises zeolite__.

4. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition, __wherein said extrusion aid is distinct from said desiccant__.

5. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof, __and wherein said extrusion aid functions as a processing aid during formation of said composition__.

6. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate __and wherein said desiccant is provided at about 5-35 weight percent of the total composition__.

7. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __and wherein said desiccant comprises a material that adsorbs substances that accelerate decomposition of said carboxylic acid__.

8. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid __and wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

13. (Currently amended) A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, __wherein said desiccant is configured to adsorb substances that accelerate decomposition of said carboxylic acid fuel__.

14. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __and wherein said desiccant maintains thermal stability of said composition during storage__.

15. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate __and wherein said desiccant comprises a material that inhibits further decomposition of said carboxylic acid fuel__.

16. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, __wherein said desiccant functions to increase thermal stability of said composition__.

17. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite __and wherein said zeolite adsorbs radicals generated by decomposition of said carboxylic acid fuel__.

18. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __and wherein said desiccant comprises zeolite that inhibits decomposition of said carboxylic acid fuel__.
